description: This file defines the YamlSettingsLoader class responsible for loading, caching, and processing YAML configuration files in the Goteo project. It supports retrieving cache files, parsing YAML content, and exporting configurations as PHP arrays.

classes.name: YamlSettingsLoader
classes.description: A class extending Symfony's FileLoader to load YAML configuration files, cache them as PHP files, and determine support for YAML file types.

methods.name: getCacheFilename
methods.description: Generates a cache filename based on the resource path by hashing it.

methods.name: getConfigCache
methods.description: Returns a ConfigCache object for given cache file, using application's debug mode setting.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a YAML configuration file, caches it as a PHP array if needed, and returns the resulting configuration.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the loader supports the given resource based on its extension (expects yml).

methods.name: exportPhpArrayAsString
methods.description: Exports a PHP array as a string representation, including auto-generated comments with class name and current date.
